extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers/contributors attempting to create or locate an article titled 'Comedy pandemic'
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who find that a Wikipedia article title does not exist and for contributors preparing or requesting a new article. Covers account requirements, searching for existing content, handling redirects/capitalization, deletion checks, and submission options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must have an account and meet the autoconfirmed status before creating articles; otherwise use alternative submission routes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot directly create the page (e.g., not autoconfirmed), the article wizard helps create a draft for community review, or you can request that someone else create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Comedy pandemic' in existing articles. Please search for 'Comedy pandemic' in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, thoroughly search Wikipedia for existing articles, alternative capitalizations, spelling variants, or similar topics to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspecting incoming links can reveal existing coverage or redirects and helps determine whether a new article is necessary or where a redirect should point.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay in visibility / use purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an expected page isn't visible, consider database propagation delays and use the purge function before assuming the page doesn't exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants of the title and create redirects where appropriate so readers find the intended article regardless of capitalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a previously existing page is missing, consult the deletion log to learn whether it was deleted and why; this informs whether recreation is appropriate and how to address issues that led to deletion.
